description: The Knowledge Repository store (Section 6, task 57): filed claims, experiments, cycles and sources. A repository file holds four arrays; every entry keeps the query axes level (evidence_level), department, agent and date (recorded_at). Only verifier-agreed results enter as confirmed; everything else enters as unconfirmed with its capped level (see verify.gate_write).

queryAxes.description: Axes every filed entry carries so the repository is queryable by level, department, agent and date.

agent.description: Agent that filed or produced the entry.

date.description: Calendar date of filing (YYYY-MM-DD), derived from recorded_at.

department.description: Lab department: bio, chem, physics-math, materials, or general.

level.description: Evidence ladder level 0-6 (never above the record's own level).

claim.description: A filed claim at its recorded evidence level, never above it.

confirmed.description: True only when a verifier-agreed comparison backs the claim.

experimentRef.description: Pointer to an experiment record in the ledger.

sourceRef.description: Pointer to a literature source record.
